answer: Locks are published in shale, expire in thread, and meadow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 79 aliases as a result needs 105 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 572 identities would post 1705 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
